packet.title: Function library: core (implementation)
packet.summary: Implements the first function library parts: the numeric, string, sequence, node, context and error functions the slice and driver use, and the xs: constructors.

body.p: After , . Owns src/function_library.c, src/function_library_{numeric,string,sequence,node,context,error}.c, tests/function_library_test.c. Used by the slice: abs avg boolean ceiling codepoints-to-string concat count current-date current-time data deep-equal distinct-ordered-nodes doc error false floor last local-name not number position QName random-number-generator reverse root round sort starts-with string string-join string-length subsequence substring sum tokenize true upper-case year-from-date; for the driver and a margin: contains current-dateTime distinct-values empty ends-with exists head max min name normalize-space tail; xs: constructors. Done when each has a unit case (deep-equal 4.0 rules, FOER0000). Spec: F&O 4.0 per function. Done 2026-10-16 (): also deep-equal and case-table files, fn:sort and fn:replace resumable; partial deep-equal options documented in .
